decisive_items: Earlobe tissue fluid showed acid-fast bacilli (Bacterial Index 4.8)
Nodular infiltrates of foamy histiocytes in dermis arranged in storiform pattern
response.rationale: R4 is the only candidate compatible with AFB-positive dermal histiocytic infiltrates and a high bacterial index; the autoantibodies are nonspecific and can accompany mycobacterial infection, while R1-R3 lack AFB and have incompatible histologic patterns.

rejected.why: Erythema nodosum is a panniculitis with tender nodules; no AFB or foamy histiocytes are described.
Sarcoidosis requires non-caseating granulomas and is AFB-negative; storiform foamy histiocytes with AFB are not sarcoid.
Lupus erythematosus is not supported by AFB-positive histiocytic infiltrate and grenz zone; positive serologies are nonspecific.
